visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young individuals—two females and one male—are seated around a low coffee table in a bright, minimalist living room. A pink electric BBQ grill is the centerpiece, laden with shrimp, scallops, meat slices, and vegetables. One female on the left with long brown hair focuses on grilling, while the others hold beverages. (2) One female character with her hair tied back is seen in a clean, brightly lit modern supermarket aisle. She is dressed in a beige outfit and is carefully selecting fresh green vegetables and placing them into a black shopping basket. (3) The same female displays various premium food packages to the camera in front of a white wall. The packages include high-grade Wagyu beef from 'Mori Seinikuten' and scallops, featuring clear labels and red/black packaging. (4) Close-up shots of the grilling process show raw meat slices being placed on the hot grill, sizzling next to corn, bell peppers, and large shrimp. A brush is used to apply thick brown sauce, and a seasoning bottle sprinkles green herbs. (5) A male character in a grey vest and white t-shirt interacts excitedly with the grilling female. He uses a smartphone to take selfies with a piece of cooked meat held up on chopsticks. His facial expressions are exaggerated and joyful. (6) The supermarket interior is shown again with a focus on fresh produce sections. Rows of packaged vegetables under bright LED lighting are visible. A person walks toward a checkout counter with a Mia C'bon logo, where a digital screen and promotion signs are prominent. (7) The three friends are seen together again in the living room, celebrating. They hold up meat and food items, smiling and cheering toward the camera as a final celebratory shot.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic, high-tempo electronic pop BGM kicks in immediately. A clear, high-arousal female voice introduces the group activity with an excited tone. SFX: A sharp 'ding' and a cartoon-style 'pop' sound coincide with on-screen text appearing. (2) Vocal texture shifts as a female voice narrates the shopping process; the pitch is friendly and professional. Subtle ambient room tone from a store environment is audible. SFX: The crinkling of a plastic bag and the sound of items being placed in a basket are heard. (3) A loud, crisp sizzling sound dominates as meat is placed on a grill. The female speaker's tone becomes more instructional and enthusiastic. SFX: Percussive brush sounds and metallic clinks of tongs occur rhythmically. (4) The male speaker enters with high intensity and high pitch variability, expressing comedic amazement. BGM beat strength remains constant. SFX: A digital camera shutter sound effect triggers as a selfie is taken. (5) The male voice reaches peak arousal, shouting in a playful, exaggerated manner about the food quality. BGM volume swells slightly. SFX: A comical 'slide whistle' or similar variety effect accompanies his reaction. (6) The audio transitions to a clean promotional narration. A female voice provides information about store benefits with clear articulation and moderate speed. SFX: A paper receipt tear sound is audible. (7) Final phase features a synchronized group shout with high energy. The BGM concludes with a rhythmic finale and a fading electronic sting.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Comedy Skit (4 types of people) -> Resolution/Source Reveal -> Product Showcase -> Promotional Details -> CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously present common social archetypes during a BBQ party to promote Mia C'bon supermarket's premium ingredients (Wagyu, seafood, pomelos) and its mid-autumn festival cash-back promotion.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the supermarket name 'Mia C'bon', filming inside the store, showing specific brand packaging (Mori Seinikuten), and announcing a specific promotional offer with dates.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully blends short-form comedy trends with high-quality food cinematography. The use of variety-show style text and sound effects keeps engagement high for a promotional message.
